The climate is continental with a strong diurnal shift: hot days (up to 35°C in summer) push ripening, while nights drop to 10°C, preserving acidity. Malolactic fermentation happens in tank, not barrel, to keep the texture smooth but not buttery. The Cot and Cabernet Sauvignon (usually <10% combined) are co-fermented with the Malbec, a technique that integrates their herbal and tannic contributions without making them stand out as separate flavors. This is a wine made for early drinking, but the tannin structure and acidity give it a few years of life.
